verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents a disputes management area ("Preventing fraudulent disputes"), dedicated disputes testing scenarios, and webhook events that report "progress on disputes," showing the platform supports dispute lifecycle tracking. However, there is no evidence of the actual structured-evidence submission workflow (e.g., uploading proof documents, dispute reason codes, response deadlines) or a documented end-to-end resolution tracking UI/API. Missing for 10: documentation of evidence submission fields/API, dispute status states and resolution outcomes, and any dashboard/API walkthrough of responding to a chargeback.
